# `matter/contracts/MatterContracts.js`

> **Source:** `engine/matter/contracts/MatterContracts.js`

Strict, app-neutral contracts for immutable matter definitions and runtime state.

### `snapshotMatterState(value, path = '$.matterState')`

Reuse a proven immutable state, or detach and validate a raw state. Unlike the constructor, this admission boundary never stamps missing schema data.

### `createMatterEmptyState(templateState, regionId)`

Create an empty root owner from admitted definition/representation metadata. The template must have no species entries, momentum, heat or charge. Its physical fields and derived caches are omitted; ancestry and revision start afresh. Raw templates still cross the full state-admission boundary.

### `snapshotMatterStates(values, path = '$.matterStates')`

Detach raw containers; reuse only lists already admitted and frozen here.

### `replaceMatterConserved(value, conserved, options = EMPTY_STATE_CHANGE)`

Replace conserved values while sharing proven immutable metadata. New values use the constructor's same validators. Omit derived to preserve it, or pass null to discard that cache; revision defaults to the next revision.

### `replaceMatterInternalEnergy(value, internalEnergyJ, options = EMPTY_STATE_CHANGE)`

Replace only retained internal energy. Unchanged conserved descendants are shared exclusively from an admitted canonical state; arbitrary supplied inventories must still use replaceMatterConserved's full validation.

### `snapshotMatterNumericArray(value, Type, path)`

Detach numeric ABI input without invoking caller iterators or accessors. Shared storage cannot supply an atomic snapshot of an inventory request.

### `replaceMatterConservedPacked(values, packed, options = EMPTY_STATE_CHANGE)`

Replace a batch of conserved inventories from a sparse numeric carrier. CSR species rows preserve absent versus explicit-zero species and key order. Each dynamics row is momentum x/y/z, internal energy, then electric charge. Admission copies every caller carrier before validating and committing it.
